info.name: RECAP4NDC Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all API endpoints in the RECAP4NDC Forest Monitoring and Patrolling System (FMPS). Covers authentication, patrol management, NDVI analysis, incident reporting, boundary management, notifications, hierarchy/dropdown data, support tickets, audit logging, and system health.

Setup:
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your API server (default: http://localhost:5002)
2. Run 'Admin Login' or 'Forest Officer Login' first to get a token
3. The login requests have a post-response script that auto-sets the `token` variable
4. All protected endpoints inherit Bearer token auth from the collection
